fidelity_invariants.F-02: Typed/normalized fields are deterministic mirrors and must not overwrite raw source.
fidelity_invariants.F-03: Missing and present-empty must remain distinguishable.
fidelity_invariants.F-04: XML attribute identity preserves namespace, name, and case.
fidelity_invariants.F-05: Greek surface text must not undergo destructive normalization.
fidelity_invariants.F-06: Lemma must not replace token occurrence.
fidelity_invariants.F-07: Exact canonical membership comes from tree ancestry, not Start/End or an envelope.
fidelity_invariants.F-08: Upstream identifiers require source, edition, and version scope.
fidelity_invariants.F-09: Unknown/unresolved information is retained or explicitly diagnosed, never silently discarded.
fidelity_invariants.F-10: MACULA annotations are not automatically BRW evaluated interpretations.
